claims.statement: A pure m-qubit core with CE e and any single-qubit spectator of purity r has both roofs e and U=(1+r)e/2.
Bell spectator has both roofs 1/4 and U=3/16; failures occur arbitrarily near purity.
claims.dependencies: Support theorem and exact rational arithmetic

claims.statement: The optimal dimension-independent additive impurity coefficient is 1/2 for both roofs.
claims.hypotheses: All finite n; coefficient independent of n

claims.statement: The fixed-n concave coefficient is 1/2-2^-n; the two-qubit convex coefficient is zero.
claims.hypotheses: n>=1 for concave; n=2 for convex

claims.statement: The convex roof is unchanged by adjoining an arbitrary mixed single-qubit spectator to an arbitrary mixed core.
claims.hypotheses: Mixed core allowed; one-qubit spectator; convex roof only
claims.dependencies: Complementary purities, conditional ensembles, product ensemble

claims.statement: The depolarised family has convex roof max(0,3q-1)^2/16 and U=(9+3q^2)/64; a radius-1/200 trace-distance ball around q=19/20 consists of full-rank violations.
claims.hypotheses: Family 0<=q<=1; full-rank strict violation above (12+sqrt(309))/33 and below 1; ball states physical
claims.proofLocation: extensions.tex: thm:noisy and subsequent radius argument
claims.dependencies: Wootters, discard inequality, fidelity witness, trace-distance bounds

claims.statement: Rank-two GME family R_z has convex roof 1/4-3z^2/16, concave roof 1/4+z/4-3z^2/8, and deficit (1-z)/16.
claims.hypotheses: 0<z<1; family defined in theorem; no full-rank claim
claims.dependencies: Support flattening minors and attained Jensen/chord bounds
